name: Letter to the Editor
card_text: +1 neutral.
flavor: A subscriber's opinion, printed at no charge.

name: Local Notice
card_text: No effect. Destroy it when you can.
flavor: Strayed cattle, a church supper. Fills the column; moves no one.

name: Editorial
card_text: +2 neutral.
flavor: The editor's own voice, always on offer.

name: Scandal
card_text: -1 prestige if staked. Destroy it when you can.
flavor: Something printed about you. It will not go away.

name: The Articles of Confederation
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican.
flavor: A league of friendship among sovereign states, with no power to tax and no one to enforce it.

name: The Kentucky and Virginia Resolutions
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Democratic.
flavor: Jefferson and Madison, anonymously, arguing that a state might judge the compact for itself.

name: Marbury v. Madison
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican.
flavor: Marshall gave up a commission and took the power to void an act of Congress.

name: Brutus and the Federal Farmer
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Democratic, +1 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: The case against ratification: a consolidated government would swallow the states and the liberties with them.

name: The Force Bill
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican, +1 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Authority to collect the tariff by arms, signed the same day as the compromise that made it moot.

name: The Federalist
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Democratic. +1 Democratic for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Eighty-five essays by Publius in the New York papers, arguing for a government that could act.

name: Mr. Madison's War
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican. +1 Republican for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: The second war of independence, or a Virginian adventure at New England expense.

name: The Indian Removal Act
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Democratic. +1 Democratic for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Congress votes the money to move the southern nations west, and calls it voluntary.

name: The Georgia Platform
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican. +1 Republican for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Georgia would accept the Compromise, and named the conditions under which it would not.

name: The Declaration of Independence
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Democratic, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Printed overnight as a broadside and read aloud from courthouse steps. Everyone would claim it.

name: Saratoga
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Republican, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Burgoyne surrendered an army, and France decided the rebellion was worth backing.

name: The Adams-Onis Treaty
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Democratic, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Spain gives up Florida, and a line is drawn to the Pacific on paper.

name: The Freeport Doctrine
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Republican, +2 Campaign (big states only). Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Douglas held that a territory could exclude slavery by simply declining to police it. It cost him the South.

name: The Mexican War
card_text: +2 neutral, +3 Democratic. +1 Democratic for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: American blood shed on American soil, if you accepted where the soil began.

name: The Lincoln-Douglas Debates
card_text: +2 neutral, +3 Republican. +1 Republican for every 3 states you hold. Retraction: draw a card, and you may destroy a Scandal in your hand or discard pile.
flavor: Seven towns, three hours each, printed verbatim in every paper in the country. Including yours.

name: The Northwest Ordinance
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Congress would govern the western territories, and no slavery would cross the Ohio.

name: McCulloch v. Maryland
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Maryland taxed the national bank; Marshall ruled the power to tax is the power to destroy.

name: The Tariff of Abominations
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Written to be so bad it would fail, and passed anyway.

name: The Report on Manufactures
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Hamilton on why a farming republic should build factories it does not yet want.

name: The Boston Tea Party
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Three shiploads of East India tea in the harbour, and a question about who governs a colony.

name: The Tariff of 1816
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: The first protective tariff, passed by southerners who had learned what a blockade does.

name: The Bank of the United States
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Hamilton's bank, chartered under powers the Constitution never named. Jefferson called it unconstitutional.

name: The Cumberland Road
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: A federal highway reaches the Ohio at Wheeling. Who pays to mend it is another question.

name: The American System
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Clay wanted tariffs, a bank and roads, and to be remembered for all three.

name: The Specie Circular
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Public land for gold and silver only. The paper economy discovered how thin it was.

name: The Free Soil Party
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Free soil, free speech, free labor and free men. Van Buren ran on it and handed New York to Taylor.

name: The Compromise of 1850
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. You may destroy a card in your hand or discard pile. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Five bills passed separately because no majority existed for all five together.

name: The Louisiana Purchase
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Democratic. Gain a story costing 4 or less from the exchange. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Fifteen million dollars, and a strict constructionist who could not find the clause.

name: The Gadsden Purchase
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Republican. Gain a story costing 4 or less from the exchange. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Ten million dollars of desert, bought for a southern railroad route.

name: The Pacific Railroad Surveys
card_text: +3 neutral, +2 Democratic. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Every proposed route was an argument about which section would own the future.

name: The Gold Rush
card_text: +4 neutral, +2 Republican. Gain a story costing 5 or less from the exchange. +1 neutral for each other Economic story you play this turn.
flavor: Ninety thousand people crossed a continent in a year, and California wanted in at once.

name: The Bill of Rights
card_text: +1 neutral, draw 1 card. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Ten amendments, the first of which said Congress shall make no law abridging the freedom of the press.

name: The Democratic-Republican Societies
card_text: +1 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Clubs of mechanics and farmers toasting France. Washington blamed them for the rebellion in the west.

name: The Cherokee Phoenix
card_text: +1 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Printed at New Echota in English and Sequoyah's syllabary, while Georgia eyes the land beneath it.

name: The Wilmot Proviso
card_text: +1 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Neither slavery nor involuntary servitude in any territory taken from Mexico. It passed the House eight times.

name: The Gazette of the United States
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Fenno's paper followed the government to New York and spoke for Hamilton's Treasury.

name: The National Gazette
card_text: +2 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Freneau's opposition paper, subsidised by a clerkship in Jefferson's own State Department.

name: The Chesapeake Affair
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: A British broadside into an American frigate in American water. Impressment made personal.

name: The Missouri Compromise
card_text: +2 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: A fire bell in the night, muffled for thirty years by a line at 36 degrees 30 minutes.

name: The Amistad
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Africans who seized a slave ship were tried in Connecticut. John Quincy Adams took their case to the Supreme Court.

name: The Liberator
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Republican, draw 1 card.
flavor: Garrison's weekly in Boston: "I will not equivocate - I will not excuse - and I will be heard."

name: Common Sense
card_text: +2 Democratic, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +2 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Paine's pamphlet ran through edition after edition in months. Kings, it turned out, were optional.

name: The Lowell Mills
card_text: +2 Republican, draw 1 card. If you play another Social story this turn, +2 neutral. Defense: discard this from your hand to ignore a negative story, and draw a card.
flavor: Textile capital with a moral architecture attached, and a constituency for protection.

name: Uncle Tom's Cabin
card_text: +1 neutral, +2 Democratic, draw 2 cards. If you play another Social story this turn, +1 neutral.
flavor: Three hundred thousand copies in a year. The best-selling argument any of you ever printed.

name: The Newburgh Conspiracy
card_text: +1 neutral. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Unpaid officers threatened Congress. Washington fumbled for his spectacles and talked them down.

name: The Hartford Convention
card_text: +1 neutral. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: New England Federalists met in secret to discuss leaving, and destroyed their own party.

name: Denmark Vesey
card_text: +1 neutral. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Charleston hangs thirty-five men for a rising that never happened, and tightens every law it has.

name: Shays' Rebellion
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Farmers closed the courts in western Massachusetts, and the Confederation could do nothing about it.

name: The Whiskey Rebellion
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Thirteen thousand militia marched on western Pennsylvania to collect a tax on whiskey.

name: The Anti-Masonic Party
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: A stonemason vanishes in western New York, and a crusade against secret societies becomes a party.

name: The Gag Rule
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet discards a card at random; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Antislavery petitions tabled unread, which turned the right of petition into the argument.

name: The Boston Massacre
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Five dead on King Street. Revere's engraving of it outsold anything true.

name: The Burr Conspiracy
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: A former Vice President tried for treason over a western empire. Jefferson wanted him hanged; Marshall let him walk.

name: The Dorr Rebellion
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Rhode Island briefly had two governors, over who was allowed to vote.

name: His Accidency's Vetoes
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Tyler vetoed the Whig bank twice. His cabinet resigned and his party expelled him.

name: The Filibusters
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Walker took Nicaragua with fifty-eight men and reinstated slavery there.

name: The Lecompton Constitution
card_text: +1 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: A proslavery constitution written by a minority, which split the Democratic party in two.

name: Bleeding Kansas
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Two territorial governments, two constitutions, and a body count. Circulation soared.

name: The Caning of Charles Sumner
card_text: +2 neutral, +1 Republican. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Beaten unconscious on the Senate floor. The South sent Brooks replacement canes.

name: The Panic of 1837
card_text: +2 neutral, +2 Democratic. Attack: each rival outlet gains a Scandal; +1 neutral if it hits any of them. Worth 1 prestige.
flavor: Six years of depression, and a president renamed Van Ruin for the duration.

name: The First American Daily
card_text: Stays in play for the rest of the game. Ongoing: at the start of each of your turns, +1 neutral. Every other outlet gets +1 Republican at the start of each of its turns.
flavor: The Pennsylvania Packet went daily. Advertisers discovered they could reach a city every morning.

name: The Cheap Postage Act
card_text: Stays in play for the rest of the game. Ongoing: at the start of each of your turns, +1 neutral. Every other outlet gets +1 Democratic at the start of each of its turns.
flavor: Congress cut newspaper postage again, and the country weekly reached its county for next to nothing.

name: The Penny Press
card_text: Stays in play for the rest of the game. Ongoing: at the start of each of your turns, draw 1 card. Every other outlet gets +1 Republican at the start of each of its turns.
flavor: A cent a copy, sold in the street rather than by subscription. Your own trade, industrialised.

name: The Associated Press
card_text: Stays in play for the rest of the game. Ongoing: at the start of each of your turns, +2 neutral. Every other outlet gets +1 Democratic at the start of each of its turns.
flavor: New York papers pooled the cost of news from the Mexican War, and sold it to everyone else.

name: The Rotary Press
card_text: Stays in play for the rest of the game. Ongoing: at the start of each of your turns, +1 neutral and draw 1 card. Every other outlet gets +1 Republican at the start of each of its turns.
flavor: Hoe's type-revolving press printed thousands of sheets an hour. Circulation was now limited by readers, not machines.
